items.title: Actual PBPS conditional closed-gradient zero implies AE constant

source.anchor: PBPS arXiv:2609.06905v1 Section2.2 conditional Poincare and AppendixC.1 omitted full-space gradient kernel background; SPHMC arXiv:2609.06906v1 Section4.1 BL background. Authored prerequisite, not a numbered theorem or complete kernel equality/Poincare/BL.
source.attribution: Samplinglib authored full-space analytic prerequisite toward PBPS conditional Poincare and separate SPHMC BL; not a quoted numbered theorem or full kernel equality/paper result.

items.statement: Construct actual common J/R/S and for each y SAME original dense/closable/exact compact-gradient D_y before ALL closure-domain elements u. Every such u with D_y.closure u=0 is S_y-AE ONE real constant. Actual laws, source hypotheses and partitions remain; no joint measurable selector or full kernel/Poincare result.
assumptions: Full finite real Hilbert/Borel E including0; V C2 with NNReal 0<alpha<=beta and actual all-point/all-vector alphaI<=HessV<=betaI. eta>0 and beta*eta<=1 are retained from the genuine conditional parent.

Actual common Gaussian J=(x,x+sqrteta*xi)#(mu*standardGaussian), Markov/disintegrating R and reflected S_y=(2x-y)#R_y. True W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+norm(z-y)^2/(8eta), S_y=volume.tilted(-W_y), integrable/positive partition and SAME dense closable exact original gradient D_y are produced before ALL closure-domain u.

formulae.label: Actual PBPS conditional closed-gradient zero implies AE constant
formulae.tex: \exists R,S\ \forall y\ \exists D_y\ \forall u\in\operatorname{dom}\overline D_y:\quad\overline D_yu=0\Longrightarrow\exists c:\ u=c\quad S_y\text{-a.e.}

obligations.label: Both main results and actual-input expected-cost composition (remaining)

bindings.boundary: Full finite real Hilbert/Borel E including0 and actual full-space volume. Genuine locally-volume-L1 u, all C1 compact directional tests with legal integrable products and zero weak derivative imply ONE real constant volume-AE. Actual normalized Gibbs W C1/exp(-W) integrable, SAME original exact compact-smooth graph D and closability give closed-gradient-zero implies weighted-AE constant. Actual PBPS common Gaussian J/R/S and original dense D_y precede ALL closure-domain u; source C2 curvature/eta cap/positive partitions retained but no additional curvature is needed by the generic kernel leaf. Only one direction; constants-domain converse, full kernel equality, centered residual/epsilon0/range/Poincare/BL/core and both main/composition remain open. No global-volume integrability of constants, classical differentiability of rough u, Nontrivial E, final kernel certificate, spectral gap or joint fiber selector. TV never transfers unbounded cost.
